title: multi run --tools files and kb restrict an agent with --allowedTools, which bypassPermissions ignores
goal: A multi run agent's tool set (--tools files, --tools kb) is restricted with claude's --tools list, not --allowedTools under --permission-mode bypassPermissions, so the files agent has only Read, Grep and Glob (review of SP-5y4ut64g, gate g3 of ST-ykdwo7a3 changed).

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
def clean(*dirs):
    import bench_multi
    for d in dirs:
        shutil.rmtree(bench_multi.clone_path(d, 1).parent, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
try:
    r = bench("multi", "run", "lookups", "--dry-run", "--tools", "files", "--dir", os.path.join(T, "none"))
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[-400:]
    assert "--allowedTools" not in r.stdout, "the files agent is limited by --allowedTools, which bypassPermissions ignores"
finally:
    clean()
